prompt_text:
Simulate two bilingual software engineers (Li and Sarah) working remotely across time zones. 
Use reasoning (chain of thought) to plan a natural English–Mandarin dialogue about resolving a deployment bug, 
then output only the conversation (5–7 turns). 
Mix Mandarin and English at the phrase level, like real bilingual speech.
Include at least one of: deploy, build, bug, deadline, merge.
Use casual engineering tone, short to medium turns, 35–50% Mandarin content.
dialogue_text:
Li: Hey Sarah, I noticed a bug in our latest deployment. 我们需要尽快解决这个问题.

Sarah: Yeah, I saw that too. Let's take a look at the code changes that were merged. 可能是最近合并的代码引起了这个bug.

Li: I think it might be related to the build process. 我觉得我们可能要检查一下构建过程中是否有什么问题.

Sarah: That's a good point. Let's check the logs to see if there were any errors during the deployment. 我们也可以看一下日志，看看部署过程中是否出现了任何错误.

Li: I'll also reach out to the team to see if anyone else has encountered this issue. 我们可以问问团队其他成员是否遇到过这个问题.

Sarah: Sounds like a plan. Let's try to resolve this bug before the deadline. 我们一定要在截止日期之前解决这个bug.

Li: Agreed. I'll update you on any progress I make. 我会及时告诉你我取得的进展.

Sarah: Great, thanks Li. Let's work together to fix this issue as soon as possible. 谢谢你的帮助，我们一起努力尽快解决这个问题.
